describe.description: The image shows a single large, muscular four-legged felid standing in right-facing side profile with its head turned to face the viewer. Its coat is predominantly tawny golden-brown with a paler off-white underbelly, chest, throat and chin, overlaid with faint to distinct narrow dark stripes. It has a broad head with a short muzzle, small rounded ears, a shaggy ruff of longer fur around the neck and chest, four sturdy legs ending in large paws, and a short thin tail with a dark tip. The animal is rendered in detailed naturalistic style against a plain off-white background with a soft shadow beneath its feet, resembling a vintage scientific illustration.

describe.description: A large, powerfully built four-legged felid shown in side view with its head turned toward the viewer. It has dense short tawny golden-brown fur, paler cream-white on the lower cheeks, chest, belly and lower legs, with faint narrow dark striping over the back, sides, legs and tail. The body is long and muscular with a deep chest, thick straight forelegs and bent hindlegs ending in large paws, and a short thin tail with a dark tip. The head is broad and cat-like with a short muzzle, rounded ears, and a slightly longer ruff of fur around the cheeks and under the neck.
